SIDE-BY-SIDE GRID WIDGETS                                  
─────────────────────────                                  
                                                           
▌ First  Wide lays out The notes fan out into columns when 
▌ the surface is wide.                                     
                                                           
▌ Second  Each note wraps inside its own cell at the shared
▌ cell width.                                              
                                                           
▌ Third Narrow it below the floor and the row stacks again.
                                                           
INGEST                                                     
Decode doc                                                 
Parse the envelope into a block tree.                      
source: cli                                                
↓                                                          
EMIT                                                       
Write out                                                  
Flush the composed lines to the terminal.                  
source: tui
